summary: }}rs80357906, also known as 5382insC, c.5266dupC, c.5263_5264insC and p.Ser1755?fs, is a variant in the BRCA1 gene considered pathogenic for breast cancer in ClinVar. This BRCA1 mutation is considered a founder mutation in several populations including Ashkenazi Jews. rs80357906 is equivalent to rs397507247 (which is occasionally found in some older data). 23andMe name: i4000378
